contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constantius II (323-361); Two Victories issue of 347-348, Trier mint, Reece period 17. Chipped. Possibly RIC vol. 8 page 151 no. 187. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed and cuirassed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [--]CON[---]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other and holding up wreaths. A star…
